preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plugin_definition WHERE plugin_definition_key = 'http-client-authentication-plugin'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO plugin_definition (plugin_definition_key, title, description, class_name) SELECT 'http-client-authentication', title, description, class_name FROM plugin_definition WHERE plugin_definition_key = 'http-client-authentication-plugin' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM plugin_definition WHERE plugin_definition_key = 'http-client-authentication' )

INSERT INTO plugin_property (plugin_property_key, plugin_definition_key, title, required, secret, field_name, field_type) SELECT old_property.plugin_property_key, 'http-client-authentication', old_property.title, old_property.required, old_property.secret, old_property.field_name, old_property.field_type FROM plugin_property old_property WHERE old_property.plugin_definition_key = 'http-client-authentication-plugin' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM plugin_property new_property WHERE new_property.plugin_definition_key = 'http-client-authentication' AND new_property.plugin_property_key = old_property.plugin_property_key )

INSERT INTO plugin_definition_category (plugin_definition_key, plugin_category_key) SELECT 'http-client-authentication', old_category.plugin_category_key FROM plugin_definition_category old_category WHERE old_category.plugin_definition_key = 'http-client-authentication-plugin' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM plugin_definition_category new_category WHERE new_category.plugin_definition_key = 'http-client-authentication' AND new_category.plugin_category_key = old_category.plugin_category_key )
UPDATE plugin_configuration SET plugin_definition_key = 'http-client-authentication' WHERE plugin_definition_key = 'http-client-authentication-plugin'
